messages:
jamal_oncall: :rotating_light: alert — sudden traffic burst from two ASNs hitting /v1/embeddings and /v1/generate, ~6k rps aggregate. spike matches previous abuse signature. starting mitigation.

maria_net: added edge rate-limit -> 100 r/s per IP, applied WAF rule `waf-ddos-rapid-2026` (pattern: high-rate POSTs + missing UA). monitoring.

alex_sre: pushed fallback routing for affected tenants to eu-west2 pool and enabled short TTL cache for common prefixes. reducing backend load.

lina_sec: can we rotate any long-lived service keys used by the ingestion pipeline? also request: enable KMS key usage audit export for the customer KMS key used by embeddings. need logs for compliance.

jamal_oncall: granted temporary role `ddos-mitigator` to @jamal_oncall for 1h (RBAC emergency grant). audit-bot: `RBAC change recorded: ddos-mitigator granted -> jamal_oncall (expires 1h)`

deploy-bot: deploy notification: `waf rule waf-ddos-rapid-2026 applied to edge config v2026.3.15-2`

lina_sec: filing KMS audit export request: please write logs to s3://redwood-audits/ddos/1935034567.csv and preserve for 90d. also open vuln ticket to triage potential path amplification vectors.

tara_cs: drafting customer note: "We detected abusive traffic affecting embeddings/generation. Mitigations in place. No data exposure. Some customers saw increased latencies briefly." pinging @legal_jp for signoff.

legal_jp: ok on the high-level text, add exact timeframe and a support contact. please hold public post until SRE confirms no residual risk.

alex_sre: backend 502s peaked but stabilized after WAF + fallback; blackhole route added for ASN 36000 for 1h — traffic reduced ~88%.

maria_net: charts show latency back to baseline, connection churn down. keeping rate-limit and WAF rule for another 30m then step down.

jamal_oncall: post-incident action items (quick): 1) Make `ddos-mitigator` emergency RBAC runbook + automation; 2) Auto-export KMS key usage on anomalies; 3) Add ASN-based heuristics to WAF rule generator; 4) Customer comms template + legal checklist. tagging @lina_sec @alex_sre @tara_cs.

lina_sec: will add check for KMS entitlement audits and document short-lived RBAC flows. I also want a follow-up to evaluate whether any internal API keys need rotation — creating ticket SEC-1935.

jamal_oncall: thanks team. I'll keep thread open for 1h for monitoring then file the incident stub into postmortems. :thumbsup:
